notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Update:
Clans totally work, Join, Leave, Changing Roles, etc.
Players can no longer damage party members or guild members.
HP Leech no longer allows you to regenerate health after death.
UI Updates
Hover over item to see stats.
Boss has skills now.
Some balancing.
Refine NPC. (Break down useless items into tokens that can be exchanged for refine powder)
Shops (Potions & Tier 1 Shop) Note: Tier 1 (Low) items will not dismantle.
Dismantling. (Allow you to break down Tier 1 (Medium) and above into tokens.
Refining up to 250.
Refining powders drop from enemies at a low rate.
Verification for deleting characters. (UI Asking if you would like to actually delete your character.)
Party UI Added (Allows you to see who is in your party on the right side of the screen)
Player & Guild Storage. (Allowing you to store items)

Planned updates this week:
Add more skills for players & enemies.
Dungeon that will be much larger than the beginning dungeon with many more enemies & bosses.
Rebalancing. (The current dungeon is going to be a beginner dungeon for people to learn the game, which means rebalancing it for maybe level 1-10)
Tooltip UI for equipped items.
Try to finish up generic UI holders -> Updated UI.
